name: AI wa Sabaku no Bara no Yume o Miru
original_name: AIは砂漠のバラの夢を視る
source:
This is an Otome visual novel, it is a satire on highly developed industrial technology in Japan, in which the decline of human civilization, moral decays, and low birth rate gets out of control under the huge social pressure.
Someday, on her way back from work, Ruri picked up an abandoned android, Aizen. Ruri stayed up all night to repair Aizen, but due to his former hostess’ negligence of periodic inspection and maintenance, Aizen’s body function could only last for five days. So Ruri decided to spend the last five days with Aizen.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/834070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
這是一部乙女視覺小說，也是對日本高度發達工業技術的諷刺：在巨大社會壓力下，人類文明衰退、道德墮落，出生率也一路下滑，難以遏止。

某天，琉璃下班回家途中撿到一臺被遺棄的人形機器人藍染。琉璃徹夜修理藍染，但由於前任女主人疏於定期檢查和維護，藍染的身體機能只能維持五天。於是，琉璃決定與藍染共度最後五天。

[來源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/834070/]Steam[/url]]
